ota.summary: Fixes from a full code review: a quiet hold now ends if the room sensor goes silent or Comfort hold is switched off; turning Follow Me off no longer turns it back on or changes Silent/Turbo; the louvre comes back after a hold ended by the remote; a hold pause and a schedule time missed during a restart are no longer lost; taps in Frosty no longer bounce back; the Matter panel refreshes; a failed install brings Install back; hold offsets show in °F; the Unit beeper setting shows again.
